description: Vejle Parkering - Live Data is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vejle Kommune. This dataset contains live data for parking spaces in Vejle city. Data Types Data is collected through different technologies: Parking sensors Camera detection Coil detection Number plate scan Parking Spaces Currently, the dataset contains data for the following parking spaces: Church Square Volmer's Square Willy Sørensen's Square Abelone's Square Gunhilds Plads Maria Square School Street ... Coverage: Vejle Kommune. The portal shows the English title as "Vejle Parking - Live Data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vejle Kommune. Its keywords include mobilitet, IoT, Regioner og byer, Regeringen og den offentlige sektor, Transport, parkering. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2025-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
